richiami.difetto: For affected vehicles with a rear seat equipped with an ISOFIX attachment system the welded joints of the ISOFIX attachment points may have been manufactured with a defect and could fail in the event of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Users are asked to stop using ISOFIX connection points to attach child seats with immediate effect. Dealers or garages will inspect and if necessary replace the ISOFIX bracket.
richiami.titolo: ISOFIX connection system for rear seats of motorhomes and camper vans

richiami.difetto: Possibility the sunroof/front dome could detach from the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Drill additional holes and insert new screws to go into the bonded fixing points.
richiami.titolo: THE SUNROOF/FRONT DOME COULD POTENTIALLY DETACH FROM THE VEHICLE

richiami.difetto: As a result of insufficient clamp force being applied to the wheels it is possible for the wheel nuts to slacken. Eventually this could allow a wheel to detach.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the caravans that are likely to be affected to fit new wheel nuts that are treated with a dry lubricant and apply a torque of 160Nm. Labels with the appropriate information will be affixed to the caravan by the wheel arches and also stuck into the Owner's Manual.
